content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied rather than paid, so the payer’s prohibition on resubmitting an adjudicated-and-paid duplicate does not apply; no authorization or coding correction is required. The prior appeal did not resolve the CO-97 denial, while clean resubmission paid 2/2 similar claims and peer-to-peer paid 0/1, making clean resubmission the strongest remaining payer action.","action":"submit_clean"}
